subject.title: fix(feishu): WebSocket encryptKey SecretRefs are ignored at runtime

question: Should this PR intentionally make configured Feishu WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs active, even when an unavailable ref can now fail startup instead of being ignored?
rationale: Repository policy treats config, secret resolution, and fail-closed behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and source inspection confirms the PR widens the active runtime secret surface.

options.title: Accept fail-closed activation
options.body: Merge with the understanding that explicitly configured Feishu WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs are now honored and invalid refs may stop the runtime instead of being ignored.

options.title: Add upgrade-facing context first
options.body: Ask for a short PR-body or release-note context line explaining that unavailable WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs now fail closed.

options.title: Pause for compatibility guard
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want unavailable WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs to remain non-fatal until a separate migration or compatibility plan exists.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed activation
recommendation.body: Merge with the understanding that explicitly configured Feishu WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs are now honored and invalid refs may stop the runtime instead of being ignored.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the Feishu webhook `encryptKey` hardening and is the strongest routing candidate for accepting the compatibility tradeoff.
